recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file browser game titled **Mossling Wind-Letter Grove**. Preserve a canvas free-roam mobile joystick loop where a small avatar accelerates around a large world, launches when crossing rectangular wind bridges at speed, can press exactly one of three action buttons while airborne, and earns score only after clean landing with completed airborne actions. Reframe the presentation as a hand-painted fantasy grove: a mossling courier, soft cream HUD cards, warm forest audio, drifting firefly motes, vine paths, bramble hazards, and cozy end/restart copy. Optimize for portrait mobile viewports and keep all controls reachable.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a canvas free-roam arcade exploration game. The player uses a mobile joystick to build momentum across a large 5000x5000 world, crosses rectangular launch gates at sufficient speed, performs one of three trick actions only while airborne, and earns score only by landing after completed airborne tricks. Thorn-like obstacles bump the player into the air and can interrupt control. A manual end button opens the result modal with restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer joystick movement, acceleration, friction, speed cap, and camera follow are preserved.
- Gate collision while moving faster than the threshold launches the avatar into the air.
- Three action buttons are accepted only during airborne state and share the original trick timing/landing score semantics.
- Thorn collisions still bounce the avatar, add shake/particles, and preserve the fumble risk.
- Score, end-state modal, restart, audio unlock on user gesture, and portrait HUD/control reachability are preserved.

## Remix target
The new canonical surface reframes the loop as a mossling courier wandering a hand-painted fantasy grove, folding floating wind letters during leaps across wind bridges. Hazards become bramble charms and teetering forest props; score becomes warm glow letters; failure/end becomes resting by the night fire.
